motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Council DIRECT the Department of Public Works and REQUEST the Controller to deposit all continuous cycles of grant reimbursement funds up to $30 million for the Glendale-Hyperion Complex of Bridges Project into the Road Maintenance and Rehabilitation (SBI) Fund No. 59V, Dept 50, Revenue Source 3811, Reimbursement from Other Agencies; and I FURTHER MOVE that the Council AUTHORIZE the Board of Public Works and REQUEST the Controller to appropriate any grant reimbursements for the Glendale-Hyperion Complex of Bridges Project from Road Maintenance and Rehabilitation (SBI) Fund No. 59V, Dept 50, Revenue Source 3811, Reimbursement from Other Agencies to Road Maintenance and Rehabilitation (SBI) Fund No. 59V, Dept. 50, Account Number 50CZEE, Account Name “Glendale-Hyperion Complex of Bridges” to provide cash flow and reimbursements to front­ funding sources. I FURTHER MOVE that the Department of Public Works be authorized to make any technical corrections or clarifications to the above fund transfer instructions in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers. — PRESENTED BY: HUGO SOTO-MARTINEf Councilmember, 13th Distric SECONDED BY: WY JCOL/_ AUG 1 2 2026
title: Glendale-Hyperion Complex of Bridges of Project / Road Maintenance Rehabilitation / Fund Transfer
